note: Read 2026-11-04 by the research of a series and a play in every market (scratchpad l4t: the first wave t1-t8 and the follow-up u1-u25, merged item by item, the later verdict standing where it read more): what a series' and a play's producer can draw on there. Each quote kept was found in its saved file (the integrator's check, 2026-11-04); a quote not found there was left out, and a figure with none left was left out with it. Attempts recorded for a web search the shared allowance refused were dropped, not being attempts.

sources.title: FUNDAC (Fundo para o Desenvolvimento Artístico e Cultural) home page
sources.said: O Fundo para o desenvolvimento Artistico e cultural, abreviamente designado por FUNDAC, foi criado ao abrigo do Decreto nº 9/88, de 7 de Junho … MISSÃO Prestar apoio financeiro a programas de formação, bolsas de estudo, investigação sobre temas e estudos culturais, aperfeiçoamento e qualificação profissional para o desenvolvimento do trabalho cultural, preservação do património cultural e desenvolvimento artístico.

figures.finding: Not reached today. FUNDAC's site is a template (placeholder text, its menu links lead nowhere); it names no theatre call, range or rate. FUNDAC also receives 20% of a box-office additional under Decreto 57/2024.

value.fund: FUNDAC, created by Decreto 9/88 of 7 June
value.mission: financial support for training, scholarships, cultural research, professional qualification, heritage and artistic development
